card.name: First letter of a surname after a given name
card.fires_on: A single letter or broken character that starts a person's surname right after a first name or initial, in names of staff, officials or authors. Also fires on broken characters inside names.

modes.label: Surname initial
modes.description: A lone capital letter that begins a surname after a first name or middle initial.

modes.label: Broken accented character
modes.description: A split byte of a non-English letter inside a name or word.
